findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "govomniai-mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: create_agent_action_assurance_order_1usd · Private data: create_agent_action_assurance_order, create_agent_action_assurance_order_1usd, create_agent_offer_verification_order_3usd, create_federal_opportunity_qualification_order_5usd · Public sink: create_agent_action_assurance_order.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: create_agent_action_assurance_order_1usd · Private data: create_agent_action_assurance_order, create_agent_action_assurance_order_1usd, create_agent_offer_verification_order_3usd, create_federal_opportunity_qualification_order_5usd · Public sink: create_agent_action_assurance_order

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "list_machine_services" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
